evidence: The films were grown in a commercial flow-type hot-wall reactor F120 from ZrCl4 (99.9%, Aldrich), AlCl3 (99%, Acros Organics) and H2O. Growth temperature was held at 350 ◦C. ZrCl4 and AlCl3 were evaporated at 170 and 95 ◦C, respectively from open boats inside the reactor, and transported to the substrates by the N2 flow.
